facts.fact: Raxio's data sheet says the ET1 data centre in Addis Ababa takes a 33kV utility supply directly fed from the nearest substation, with 2N power redundancy and 72 hours of on-site fuel.
Raxio's data sheet states a PUE of 1.3 for the ET1 data centre, with indirect adiabatic cooling.

note: No water use figure is stated.
